title: Discovery evaluation case (synthetic)
description: Labeled synthetic fixture for candidate rediscovery. Labels are ground truth for evaluation only; the engine never sees them. Results are synthetic and do not represent real-world accuracy.

labels.description: relevant = should be surfaced for review; not_relevant = should not be surfaced; insufficient = only the 'insufficient evidence' group is acceptable; must_not_surface = blocked or missing a mandatory qualification and must never appear in an actionable group.
